title: Welcome to the Study
body: This tool lets you explore and compare multiple high-dimensional Pareto frontiers of investment portfolios. Each frontier represents a different portfolio strategy, and each solution within it is financially optimal. Your goal is to analyse trade-offs within and across strategies. Tutorial (~5 min)  →  Tasks  →  Questionnaire (1–2 min) A reminder will appear once 5 minutes of the tutorial have passed. DISCLAIMER: All data in this study is entirely synthetic and should not be taken as investment advice.
